text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a small schema change to surface per-route SLA labels in console metrics so dashboards and quota routing can filter by SLA tier. Need a migration checklist and perf/risk callout.
maria: Goal: add a stable nullable column `route_sla` to console_metrics, populate for recent data, and start dual-writing from ingest path.
devon: Which table exactly? `console_metrics` is pretty wide already. Any idea on cardinality?
maria: Yes `console_metrics` (timeseries/metrics_events store). Route_sla values are limited (gold, silver, bronze, default) — small cardinality but every row will get a value.
kiran: Small-cardinality is good. My major worry is index bloat if we add a new indexed column across the hot partition. We should avoid adding a global btree index that touches all partitions at once.
sam: Proposal: don't index the raw column. Instead create a compact materialized view for queries used by dashboards and quota lookups: `console_metrics_route_sla_mv(route_id, bucket_ts, sla, tokens, count)` and keep it compact. Update MV via incremental refresh.
alyssa: How do we do the dual-write? Want to avoid a long backfill window.
maria: Plan: feature-flag the ingestion service to write `route_sla` when available. Dual-write for 14 days; after confidence, flip flag to single-write and run backfill for historical 90d.
deploy-bot: migration-runner queued: migration 2026-03-add-route-sla-col (no-op preview passed).
kiran: Backfill approach (no-lock, batched):
```
-- pseudo-sql, run in small windows
ALTER TABLE console_metrics ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS route_sla text;
-- populate in 10k-row batches by id range to avoid long locks
UPDATE console_metrics cm
SET route_sla = r.sla
FROM routes r
WHERE cm.route_id = r.id
AND cm.id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
```

kiran: Do NOT create a full-table index immediately. Run queries against MV or use a lightweight hash-based partial index for active routes only.
sam: Also consider maintaining a per-route summary table (daily) we can use in quota decisions: `route_sla_daily(route_id, day, sla, tokens)` — much cheaper for routing. We can generate that as part of the backfill.
devon: What about retention and storage cost? Adding column is cheap but backfill + MV will double storage during backfill. Estimate: 90d backfill ~ +850GB. We need sign-off from infra quota.
infra-bot: infra-quota: current headroom for analytics cluster is 1.1TB. Approvals required for >1TB temporary spikes.
alyssa: For dashboards: update saved views to prefer MV and add a fallback to raw table if MV misses. We'll need support tickets + changelog so SRE/customers know behavior.
maria: Rollout timeline (tentative):
- Week 1: add nullable column + feature flag dual-write in staging (smoke).
- Week 2: enable dual-write canary (10% routes), monitor MV errors and ingestion lag.
- Week 3: dual-write 100% + run incremental backfill for last 30d.
- Week 4: run full 90d backfill during a weekend maintenance window, promote MV.
- Week 5: remove feature flag and retire old flow.

maria: Rollback plan: flip flag off to stop writing route_sla, run small cleanup if false data observed, drop MV and revert dashboards to raw queries.
devon: Preflight checklist?
maria: Action items:
1) kiran: produce backfill script with batching and safety limits (ETA 2d).
2) sam: materialized view definition + refresh scheduling + cost estimate (ETA 3d).
3) infra: confirm storage headroom for temporary spike and approve maintenance window (ETA 1d).
4) alyssa: update dashboard views and support docs; prepare customer comms (ETA 5d).
5) devon: run perf tests on staging for typical dashboard queries against MV vs raw (ETA 4d).

sam: +1. I'll prototype MV and show query latencies. Expect big gains for dashboard queries. :thumbsup:
kiran: I'll size the batch update jobs and add idempotency tokens so we can resume safely.
alyssa: I'll draft the UI change and set up a canary dashboard to monitor mismatches.

maria: Thanks all — will create a PR with the migration DDL + checklist and assign tasks. Ping me if you see blockers.
